correctness.rationale: In the local algebra with x_ix_j=0 and x_i^{n_i}=0, every proper ideal is the inverse image of a full-coordinate-support leading subspace after all higher pure-branch tails, because multiplication by x_i forces each tail. For two ideals, branch-leading exponents add and are truncated at n_i; nonzero leading coefficients multiply coordinatewise, so the product leading subspace is the span of restricted Schur products. This proves full equality, associativity, the zero-product iff all coordinate sums reach cutoffs, and nilpotency index max ceil(n_i/a_i). Independently checked a mixed 3-branch code whose Schur square has rank 3, confirming emergence of separated leading branches. The inspected verifier algebraically enumerates 14,062 small-field pairs, but finite evidence does not establish the arbitrary-field assertion.
residual_risks: The full-support code representation presupposes positive degree proper ideals; the unit ideal is a separately adjoined identity.
